appearance.extreme: They are armoured. Segmented black plate from throat to hip and out along the limbs, matte and slightly iridescent, with the seams flexing as they breathe.
appearance.obvious: Overlapping plates of dark chitin cover their chest and run down over the shoulders, clicking faintly when they move.
appearance.subtle: Hard ridges show through their shirt across the shoulders.

description: Plates of dark chitin have grown up through your skin, overlapping like roof tiles. Nothing gets through them easily. Nothing fits over them either.
drawbacks: Conventional torso armour will not close over it
name: Chitinous Carapace
